items.title: Milford Dolliole Interview, 1965-05-22
items.q: when Saeed was taken sick, I played in his place almost a year. Probably in the Young Tuxedo band.

ctx.x: How long were you with Chris Kelly? Do you remember who else was in the band? No, well, I just played at Giles when he hired me like that, you know, when he was drumming.
But I never was in the regular. My regular was with Cloverleaf and when Saeed was taken sick, I played in his place almost a year. Probably in the Young Tuxedo band. In the Young Tuxedo?
Yeah, huh. That's the one that the picture was taken. Yeah, uh-huh.
